name: Mercedes-Benz Group AG
summary: Mercedes-Benz Group AG, operating through its global network of subsidiaries, is a prominent developer and manufacturer of a diverse range of vehicles, encompassing passenger automobiles, commercial trucks, vans, and buses. Its extensive operations are organized into three primary divisions: Mercedes-Benz Cars & Vans, Daimler Trucks and Buses, and Daimler Mobility. The Mercedes-Benz Cars & Vans segment is dedicated to crafting premium and luxury automobiles, marketed under the flagship Mercedes-Benz brand, alongside its specialized sub-brands such as Mercedes-AMG, Mercedes-Maybach, and the electric Mercedes-EQ. This division also produces compact vehicles under the smart brand, cultivates the Mercedes me digital ecosystem, and provides commercial vans and associated services via the Mercedes-Benz and Freightliner marques. Within the Daimler Trucks and Buses segment, the company manufactures and distributes a wide array of trucks and special purpose vehicles, utilizing brands like Mercedes-Benz, Freightliner, Western Star, FUSO, and BharatBenz. Additionally, it offers buses under the Mercedes-Benz, Setra, Thomas Built Buses, and FU names, in addition to supplying bus chassis. The Daimler Mobility division delivers financial services, including financing and leasing packages tailored for both end-users and dealerships. Its offerings further extend to automotive insurance brokerage, banking, investment solutions, and comprehensive fleet management services, notably under its Athlon brand. The company also engages in the distribution of vehicle-specific spare parts and accessories.
